title: IP Address Conflicts: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Imagine two houses with the same house number. The postman has no idea where to deliver. That's an I P address conflict.

scenes.heading: The mailbox mix-up
scenes.narration: When two devices share an address, trouble follows. One minute it works, and the next minute it doesn't. You may see a duplicate address warning pop up. The A R P table keeps flipping between two M A C addresses. Fixing it means changing one of the two addresses.

scenes.heading: How to find them
scenes.narration: Two commands can track them down. A R P dash a shows the M A C that answered. And the switch's M A C table shows which port it sits on.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three tips. Rebooting only hides it for a while. A D H C P pool can collide with a static address. Reservations and excluded ranges prevent it.

items.right: It returns if both keep the IP
